_comment: The NFC card pages. Each entry becomes onlymaxon.com/u/<slug>/ plus the
contact.vcf that the 'save contact' button hands to the phone.
One entry is one client, NOT one client per language: a profile carries somebody's
own name and phone number, and five copies of that under noindex would only be five
times the work per order. The 'lang' field picks the language the buttons speak.
slug      the URL: onlymaxon.com/u/<slug>/. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes.
It is printed on a card that cannot be reprinted — never change one.
lang      en | pl | ru | tr | es. Button labels only; everything else is typed here.
name      shown big, and used as the contact name when the card is saved.
role      the line under the name. Kept short — it sits on one line on a phone.
location  optional, one line.
bio       optional, one or two sentences. Longer than that stops being a card.
phone     international form, spaces allowed: +48 576 925 110.
email     optional.
website   optional, full URL.
services  optional list of { name, price }. Price is free text — '€18', 'from €390'.
links     optional list of { label, url } shown as a quiet row at the bottom.
accent    amber | rose | cyan. Same three colourways the home-page mocks use.
Nothing here goes through build/translations.js: it is somebody else's words, and a
table where every key must exist in five languages is the wrong home for those —
the same reason build/reviews.json exists.
These pages are noindex and are deliberately absent from sitemap.xml.
